Sender tile context, connection state, and metrics for signing and sending transactions to leaders.

# Purpose
This header file defines the data structures, constants, and interface state used by the sender tile that signs and sends transactions to the current leader. It sets network and QUIC parameters, port indexes, connection lifetime limits, and leader targeting rules for vote traffic, and it also declares the input and output link records used by the tile framework. The `fd_send_tile_ctx_t` structure collects all runtime state for leader tracking, QUIC connections, keyguard access, packet headers, timekeeping, and metrics. It serves as the central configuration and state definition for the send path in the codebase.
